title: Probability of a zero binary dot product
statement: Let $\phi$ be a probability density on $\mathbb F_2^n$ and let $\gamma\in\mathbb F_2^n$. The $\phi$-expectation of the indicator that the binary dot product $\gamma\cdot x$ is zero equals $\bigl(1+\mathbb E_{x\sim\phi}[(-1)^{\gamma\cdot x}]\bigr)/2$.
hypotheses_covered: $\phi$ is a probability density on $\mathbb F_2^n$
